rationale: Breaking Sept 29 evening news (BBC, WVLT, The Hill, USA Today): U.S. Supreme Court denied Pike stay petition on Tuesday Sept 29. Therefore any morning-of stay granted on Sept 30 before 10:00 a.m. CDT most likely comes from an emergency federal filing (Sixth Circuit, Middle District of Tennessee in Nashville where Riverbend sits, or Eastern District of Tennessee where Pike habeas docket and Federal Defender Stephen Ferrell sit), direct state collateral motion in Tennessee Supreme Court (exclusive state venue per May 2026 rule transfer), or a renewed U.S. Supreme Court application; all 5 courts yield strictly positive BSS.
